summary: Recent updates to the media encoders in Firefox have refined how video encoding manages timing. Specifically, the introduction of the **TimeDuration::ToTicksAtRate** function in the VideoTrackEncoder enhances the precision of timing calculations during video encoding processes. This improvement is crucial because accurate timing ensures smoother playback and better synchronization of audio and video streams, making for a more seamless viewing experience for users. Overall, these changes help elevate the quality of video processing in the browser.
